name: developer
description:
Detección, análisis, tests, builds y gestión integral de skills de IA (.md) para desarrollo de software.
Acciones e inputs de exactos: create_skill { name, description, instructions, path, rules, examples, references, scripts, overwrite } | detect_project { path } | diagnose_service { path, serviceId } | get_skill { name, path } | inspect_project { path } | list_skills { path, searchGlobal } | refresh_service_state { path, serviceId } | run_project_build { path, timeoutMs } | run_project_tests { path, timeoutMs } | validate_skill { path }
